title: ATS Benchmark Resume Dataset - Dokumentacija

dataset_structure.description: מאגר של 50 קורות חיים בפורמט JSON Resume המעוצב לבדיקת מערכות ATS

Software Engineer.reason: Core tech role - high parsing complexity

structural_variations.employment_gaps: Some resumes have deliberate 6-12 month gaps to test gap detection
structural_variations.career_transitions: 5-7 resumes show career changes (e.g., eng → product, sales → marketing)
structural_variations.short_tenures: 3-5 resumes have 6-month positions to test job-hopping patterns
structural_variations.long_tenure: 3-5 resumes have 5+ year positions at single company
structural_variations.education_timing: Mix of recent graduates (2023-2024) and experienced professionals

skills_presentation.keyword_density: High keyword density in 20% (tests keyword stuffing detection)

language_variations.formatting_inconsistencies: 5-8 resumes have inconsistent date formats, capitalizations

contact_info_variations.url_presence: 60% have LinkedIn URLs, 20% have personal portfolios, 20% have neither

edge_cases_included: Resume with no work experience (fresh graduate)
Resume with no education section (self-taught developer)
Resume with 10+ years experience vs recent graduate
Resume with non-standard job titles vs standard titles
Resume with special characters in name (e.g., אח דציק)
Resume with very long company names
Resume with URL-like text in bullet points
Resume with dates in future (error case)
Resume with very short job descriptions
Resume with very detailed job descriptions (2000+ chars)

scenario_1_keyword_matching.description: Test how ATS matches job posting keywords to resume content
scenario_1_keyword_matching.target_resumes: Mix of high-keyword-density and low-keyword-density resumes
scenario_1_keyword_matching.test_query: Match 10 sample job postings against all 50 resumes

scenario_2_skill_extraction.description: Verify accurate skill identification and level classification
scenario_2_skill_extraction.target_resumes: All 50 resumes have explicit skills section
scenario_2_skill_extraction.validation: Compare extracted skills with known skills in JSON

scenario_3_experience_calculation.description: Calculate total years of relevant experience
scenario_3_experience_calculation.edge_cases: Overlapping dates, employment gaps, career transitions

scenario_4_education_parsing.target_resumes: Mix of Bachelor, Master, MBA, certifications
scenario_4_education_parsing.validation: Compare parsed education against source JSON

scenario_5_candidate_ranking.description: Rank candidates by fit for sample job posting

scenario_6_data_quality.validation: Assess data completeness and quality scoring

skill_detection_recall.description: % of actual skills found in resume

candidate_ranking_consistency.description: Consistency of ranking across multiple test runs

usage_instructions.step_1: Load benchmark_resumes_50.json into your ATS system
usage_instructions.step_3: Export extracted data for each resume
usage_instructions.step_4: Compare extracted data with source JSON using provided validation script
usage_instructions.step_5: Calculate accuracy metrics using evaluation template
usage_instructions.step_6: Document results and areas for improvement

validation_script_structure.purpose: Compare ATS extracted data vs source JSON
